messages:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION ABORTED: attempted promotion redwood/v1.12.3 -> canary failed. Reason: artifact indexer commit TTL expired for 3 blobs during manifest write. Promotion rolled back to previous state. https://ci.internal/reports/1745660001 :eyes:

morgan: Holding on this — canary not promoted, correct?

dave: yep, CI shows `LeaseExpiredError: upload lease expired while writing manifest` in the artifact uploader. snippet: ```
ERROR UploadPart: LeaseExpiredError: lease id=abcd1234 expired after 30s while writing manifest
path: s3://artifacts/redwood/v1.12.3/manifest.json
```

carol: SRE here — seeing a ~90s spike in the indexer commit latency around that time. Most s3 puts succeeded, but indexer worker pool was saturated; it timed out commits at 30s TTL. prometheus: `indexer_commit_latency_seconds_bucket{le="30"}` shows a tail spike.

jamie: Quick question: is v1.12.3 safe to skip or do we need to pin before we cut? any migrations in that release?

dave: no DB migrations in 1.12.3, just a small telemetry change and a packaging tweak. binaries are fine.

morgan: My read: cut is blocked until artifacts are indexed (so deploybot can resolve digests). Options: 1) increase indexer TTL temporarily and re-ingest, 2) manually pin canary to last-good image (v1.12.2) and cut later, 3) retry promotion after indexer backlog drains.

jamie: given time window, I recommend temporary pin to v1.12.2 to avoid blocking customers. We'll follow up with reindex and re-run 1.12.3 in next change window. Approvals? @sara @alex pls ack.

sara: ack from Release lead. approve pin to unblock. run a smoke e2e after pin. :white_check_mark:

alex: +1. also patch release notes to mention a followup re-promote for 1.12.3.

carol: I can flip indexer TTL to 10m for the next hour to allow re-ingest, but need ops signoff. Command to patch indexer config in staging: ```
kubectl -n infra patch deploy/indexer --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"indexer","env":[{"name":"COMMIT_TTL_SEC","value":"600"}]}]}}}}'
```

morgan: I'm going to pin now. Command I'll use: `deploybot promote --image redwood/v1.12.2 --to canary --reason "temp-pin due to indexer TTL stall"`

morgan: ran promote command — got `200 OK` from deploybot. Can confirm canary now points at redwood/v1.12.2. leaving canary for smoke verification.

deploy-bot: PROMOTION SUCCEEDED: redwood/v1.12.2 -> canary (performed by morgan). link: https://deploybot.internal/promotions/1745660001

dave: once canary verification passes, we can proceed with release notes and scheduled cut. I'll open a follow-up ticket to re-ingest artifacts and attempt re-promotion of 1.12.3 in tomorrow's change window (02:00 UTC).

carol: TTL bumped to 10m temporarily. monitoring for indexer errors, will post if re-ingest completes.

jamie: summary plan: (1) temp-pin canary to v1.12.2 (done), (2) increase indexer TTL and re-ingest artifacts for 1.12.3, (3) rerun canary promotion in tomorrow change window, (4) update release notes to document the pin and re-promote.

morgan: thanks all. closing this thread once smoke e2e passes. created follow-up ticket: https://tracker.internal/RED-4521 (reindex + retry promotion).

sara: please add a short blurb in release notes: "Canary temporarily pinned to v1.12.2 due to artifact indexing delay; v1.12.3 will be reattempted after reindex."

morgan: added note, smoke checks green, marking as unblocked for now. will reopen if traces show regressions. :tada:
